resources.string: The one colour the interface spends. It does not change the app icon.
Works fully offline. The network is used only when you install a set, a table or a collection from a URL.
Roll without drawing the dice. The same roll, decided the same way — the result just appears.
Light, dark, or whatever the phone is doing.

Only a die actually hitting something ticks or makes a noise — never one sliding, never one that has stopped. The sound is the table\'s, and the pitch follows how hard the knock was and how big the die is. Both take effect the next time the roll screen opens.
Off means the motion sensors are never switched on at all, which is the one setting here that saves any power.
Which way a division rounds. The result sheet can re-round the throw in front of you; that choice is not remembered.
Free software, GPL-2.0-or-later. Your dice, your statistics, your phone — nothing is uploaded anywhere.

For debugging the physics. It adds an overlay on the tray and a Developer screen to the menu, and nothing else in the app changes — your history still has no replay and still never shows a seed. The overlay appears the next time the roll screen opens.
Debugging tools for the physics. Nothing here is reachable with the toggle off, and nothing here is written to your history or your exports.

A throw is the dice, the table, their scale, the seed and the shake that drove it — not a seed on its own. Both buttons replay the last throw made this run: one under its own seed, one under the seed you type. Neither is written down and neither touches the tray.
Nothing has been thrown yet this run.
Replay those dice from that seed
Same faces. Determinism holds on this device.
DIFFERENT FACES. The same seed came to a different roll — a release blocker.

Forced settles and post-rest corrections. Both are supposed to be impossible, so this is evidence rather than a statistic: if there is a line below, that is a bug — report it with the seed on it. The list is kept in memory and goes when the app does.
Everything the formula field understands. Tap any line to put it in the tray.
